name: quickcart
description: QuickCart - Enterprise 10-Minute Hyperlocal Fullstack Quick-Commerce Delivery Application

scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd backend && (mvnw package -DskipTests || mvn package -DskipTests)
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && (mvnw.cmd -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test || ./mvnw -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test || mvn -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test) && cd ..
scripts.test:rust: cd services/flash-sale-engine && (cargo test || echo "Rust toolchain optional locally") && cd ../..
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix frontend run test && cd backend && (mvnw.cmd -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test || ./mvnw -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test || mvn -B test -Dspring.profiles.active=test) && cd ../services/ai-demand-engine && (python -m pytest || pytest) && cd ../../services/data-pipeline && (python -m pytest tests || pytest tests) && cd ../telemetry-service && go test -v ./... && cd ../..
scripts.lint:sql: sqlfluff lint backend/src/main/resources/db/migration services/data-pipeline --dialect postgres || python -m sqlfluff lint backend/src/main/resources/db/migration services/data-pipeline --dialect postgres
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm run lint:sql
